description: This PHP file defines the Affiliate controller within the Opencart admin module, handling affiliate management features such as listing, form editing, saving, enabling/disabling, deleting, generating CSV payouts, and reports. It interacts with models to fetch and modify affiliate data, manages user inputs, and outputs views or JSON responses.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliates in the admin panel of Opencart, including listing, editing, status updates, deletion, CSV exports, and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the affiliate list page, handles filters, pagination, breadcrumbs, and loads the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to load the affiliate list fragment.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of affiliates with filtering, pagination, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an affiliate, populating fields with existing data if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving affiliate data from the form, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected affiliates by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected affiliates by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates and updates balances for all active affiliates.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Exports selected affiliates' payout data as a CSV file.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks selected affiliates' balances as paid and adds corresponding transactions.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and renders the detailed affiliate report with pagination.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an AJAX autocomplete for affiliate search by name or email.
